title.narrative: Tonga NDC3,0, LT-LEDS Review, Waste Secotor MRV and Youth Climate Change Awareness project

description.narrative: The overall objective is to strengthen Tonga's institutional and technical capacity to plan, monitor, and finance its national climate commitments under the Paris Agreement. By supporting the transition from the Second to the enhanced NDC 3.0, the project ensures Tonga maintains its momentum and ambition in global climate action. A core goal is to enable the government to track and report on its mitigation and adaptation efforts accurately, particularly within the waste sector, through a new MRV system. Ultimately, the project aims to create a viable pipeline of bankable climate investment projects and mobilize the necessary resources to achieve Tonga's long-term low-emission and climate-resilient development goals.

This 30-month technical assistance project is designed to accelerate Tonga’s climate ambition under the NDC Partnership Action Fund (PAF). The project focuses on six key outputs, starting with a comprehensive review of the Second NDC's progress. This will be followed by the development of the enhanced NDC 3.0 and its alignment with Tonga's Long-Term Low-Emission Development Strategy (LT-LEDS). A crucial component is the establishment of an MRV system for the waste sector, enabling accurate emissions tracking. Finally, the project includes capacity building through a Youth Awareness Strategy and practical support for investment pipeline planning, which involves developing concept notes and a resourcing strategy for priority projects.
